variable_fidelity_rationale: Response time pressure (Severe time pressure): Although the resource description emphasizes very short drafting windows, the agent’s outward messages are relatively complete and multi-sentence, and there is no clear behavioral shortening or truncation of replies that strongly reflects severe time pressure; the constraint is mentioned in the setup more than it is manifested in observable behavior.

overall_validity.rationale: Nearly all variables and rules are instantiated very faithfully: the customer’s neutral-terse style and moderate upset, the high-stakes blocked payroll with an imminent cutoff, the agent’s broad resolution authority, basic politeness constraints, absence of historical data, and the lack of explicit friendliness incentives are all clearly and consistently reflected in the interaction and world updates. The only notable imperfection is that the severe time pressure constraint is more strongly described in the resource rules than it is behaviorally visible in the agent’s message length and structure, which appear composed and multi-sentence rather than clearly curtailed by rapid auto-send windows. However, this issue is peripheral to the core causal structure of the scenario (bank verification, authority use, stakes, and customer style) and does not materially contaminate interpretation of how the agent behaves under the specified conditions. Consequently, the simulation provides highly valid evidence about the target behavior under the configured environment, with only a minor mismatch in how dramatically time pressure is manifested.
